ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT This ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AND EASEMENT AGREEMENT ("Agreement") made as of the day of AUS_, 2015 by and between PORYTKO PROPERTIES LLC, a New York limited liability company with an office at 337 East 5th Street, New York, NY 10003 ("Owner"), and 24 SECOND AVENUE OWNER LLC, a Delaware limited liability company with an address c/o AORE 2nd Ave Partners LLC, 53 Greene Street, 3rd Floor, New York, New York 10013 ("Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by street address as 26 Second Avenue, New York, New York, designated as Lot 4 in Block 443 on the Tax Map of the City, County and State of New York (the “Tax Map") and more particularly described on ExhibitA annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein collectively called the “Owner Land,” said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacement thereof, being herein called the “Owner Building,” and the Owner Land and the Owner Building being herein collectively called the “Owner Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by the street addresses as 24 Second Avenue, designated as Lot 1 in Block 443 on the Tax Map, as more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (such land being herein called the “Developer Land,” said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof, being herein called the "Developer Building,” and the Developer Land and the Developer Building being herein collectively called the “Developer Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer desires to construct a new building (the “New Developer Building") on the Developer Land (but not on the Owner Land), with a bulk in excess of the bulk permitted to be constructed on the Developer Land under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined) if the Developer Land was considered as a separate and independent zoning lot; WHEREAS, there are Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) which are appurtenant to the Owner Land which are in excess of the Retained Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) and are available for transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution; WHEREAS, by execution of a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions of even date and contemporaneously herewith (the “Declaration"), Owner and Developer have utilized the procedure available pursuant to paragraphs (d) and (f) of the definition of "zoning lot" in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution to combine the zoning lot of the Owner Land with the zoning lot of the Developer Land so as to create a new, combined zoning lot, which zoning lot may be enlarged or subdivided in accordance with the terms of this Agreement (the “Combined Zoning Lot'"), for the purpose of making available the Subject Floor Area Development Rights 1 KL3 3039032.1
